question.text: When aniline is nitrated with nitrating mixture in ice cold condition, the major product obtained is

solution.text: Direct nitration of aniline with nitric acid gives a complex mixture of mono, di- and tri-nitro compounds and oxidation products. If $-\mathrm{NH}_{2}$ group is protected by acetylation and then nitrated with nitrating mixture, $p$ -isomer is the main product.
